input.name: waveform
input.note: raw 16 kHz float32 in [-1,1]; mel frontend baked into the graph

output.name: cosines
output.note: teacher-space anchor cosines; apply softmax(x/T) then pose blend. T is v4-calibrated: the teacher's 0.05 divided by the 1.33 global deviation gain (teacher sd / student sd around the train mean) measured on never-trained pools — human-all + corpus-heldout, 96,577 windows (distill-calibrate.py, 2026-08-29). Argmax is temperature-invariant, so agreement with the teacher is untouched.
